question.problem:
For which of the following situations can the distribution of the sample proportion $\overset{^}{\,p}$ be approximated as

$$
\overset{^}{\,p}∼N(p,\frac{p(1-p)}{n}),
$$

where $p$ is the population proportion?

I. A sample of $50$ students from a class, where $60%$ of the students in the school have an IQ greater than $105.$

II. A sample of $60$ paid TV customers, where $80%$ of the customers watch TV more than $8$ hours per week.

III. A sample of $40$ players in a team, $90%$ of the players in the league are right-handed.

*Hint: In each case, you may assume that the population size is significantly larger than the sample size.*
